feature_name: Visitor Compilation State Reset on Error
description: Implement a fix to ensure the visitor compilation state is properly reset when an error occurs during compilation. Currently, if an invalid visitor causes a compilation error, some visitor functions from the failed compilation can persist and incorrectly affect subsequent files. This fix should wrap the linting process to guarantee state cleanup even when errors are thrown.
functional_requirements: Reset all visitor compilation state variables when an error is caught during the linting process
Ensure the reset occurs in the try/catch block that wraps the entire linting operation
Prevent visitor functions from one file from being included in the compiled visitor for subsequent files after a compilation error
